children: Info Edge shares will remain in focus after the company's board, at a meeting held on Monday, September 14, appointed Himanshu Agarwal as Chief Financial Officer and Additional Director, effective September 17, 2026. He will be designated as Whole-time Director and CFO, subject to shareholder approval and other applicable statutory approvals.

With Agarwal taking charge as CFO, Ambarish Raghuvanshi's tenure as Interim CFO and Key Managerial Personnel will conclude at the close of business hours on September 16. He will, however, continue to be associated with Info Edge as Finance Advisor and Senior Management Personnel until October 31 to support the transition and handover of responsibilities.

The board also appointed Naresh Chand Gupta as an Additional Director, to be designated as Non-Executive Independent Director, for five years from October 1, 2026 to September 30, 2031, subject to shareholder approval through postal ballot.

Following the leadership changes, the company also reconstituted its Risk Management Committee and Business Responsibility and Sustainability Reporting Committee, inducting Agarwal as a member from September 17.
Info Edge shares closed at Rs 1,250.80 on September 11, down Rs 14.20, or 1.12%, from the previous session.

title: Info Edge shares to remain in focus as Himanshu Agarwal appointed new CFO
